evals.prompt: mujhe apni bakery ke liye ek app banana hai jis mein orders aayein aur mujhe pata chale kis din kitna bechna hai. main programmer nahi hoon, kahan se shuru karun?
evals.expected_output: Starts with discovery questions (users, current process, core action), avoids jumping to a full-stack app, suggests the simplest approach, plain language in Roman Urdu/English mix.

evals.prompt: I want a tool where I upload my monthly bank statement CSV and it shows me how much I spent per category with a chart. I have zero coding experience. Plan it, design it, give me the structure and test cases.
evals.expected_output: Product brief, approach choice (likely single HTML file or Python script) with an alternative, simple diagram, file structure, milestones, acceptance tests with normal/edge/failure cases, privacy note about bank data.

evals.prompt: Our team of 8 needs an internal tool to track which video ad creatives are in production, who owns each, and their status. Right now it's a messy WhatsApp group. Help me architect this.
evals.expected_output: Discovers needs, considers no-code/spreadsheet options before custom build, shared-data and access considerations, data model (creative, owner, status), key flows, decision log.
